description: Implementation of the ProductRelationshipService interface, managing product relationship groups and relationships, including creation, activation, deactivation, deletion, and retrieval functions.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing business logic for managing product relationships, including CRUD operations and group management.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product relationship or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a new relationship group associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all product relationship groups for a store.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes all relationships within a specified group.

methods.name: deactivateGroup
methods.description: Deactivates all relationships in a group.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Activates all relationships in a group.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific product relationship after re-fetching it to avoid detached entity issues.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Lists all relationships associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves relationships based on store, product, and relationship type, possibly filtered by language.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves relationships belonging to a specific group within a store.
